We where in the GW2 Beta, and reached 80 pretty early in the game... at the time there wasn't much to do at 80 and we got bored and moved on. So what is the endgame like these days? What do people do at 80?
My wife and I recently returned to GW2 after a very long break... wow have things changed!
Also, we are really looking forward to the expansion!

GW2 is very much a horizontal progression game, so it really just comes down to what you like to do. PVP/WvW are common end-game destinations for players. If you like dungeons: the Fractals of the Mists are fairly active and provide room for vertical progression. There's achievements to work towards, crafting progression to get Ascended gear, and not to forget about the upcoming expansion which will add a lot of new content. Another cool goal to set is to unlock all the armor sets in your wardrobe so you can play dress up with your character :D. There's probably stuff I'm forgetting...

Personally, I'm leveling alternate characters so I can play their Elite Specialization when the expansion drops.
I haven't read up on it much... Elite Specializations? We have been leveling alts for fun, trying to get 4x80s before the expansion.

So instead of adding a bunch of new classes, ANet is adding specializations on top of existing classes. So far the Guardian can become a "Dragon Hunter", the Necromancer can become the "Reaper", the Mesmer can become a "Chronomancer", and the Ranger can become a "Druid". Each will bring new skills and new equip-able weapons(Such as the Guardian/Dragon Hunter will be able to wield a bow) to the class, and can be swapped out as easily as swapping skills.

There really isn't an endgame. Set some goals for yourself, and go accomplish them, like getting achievement points, a title, or creating a style and collecting the skins you'll need. Don't be afraid to try out WvW and sPvP as well!

I have two level 80's, a Warrior and a Elementalist, I mainly do World Bosses and have slowly been farming materials to craft a Legendary weapon(Juggernaught).

Most people can do endgame whenever they want, just not higher level areas, but if you want a list then: Fractals, Dungeons, World Bosses, PvP, WvWvW, Legendary weapons, Ascended gear, World Completion, Jumping Puzzles, Achievements, Living Story, Dry Top/Silverwastes, and Ecto gambling.

You can also make your own Guild and have a Guild Bank, you can't put account bound items in the Guild Bank, but extra items you may have in your personal bank can be transfered over there.

I've seen this guide posted a few times on what to do when you reach end-game. Personally, I've got 4 characters so I made a legendary and a full set of ascended armor for all of them. Now I spend my time doing WvW and dungeon runs while waiting for HoT.

I'm a casual player that logs on during new patches and updates such as the new Lion's Arch. Farming and doing dungeons the hardcore way isn't my playstyle really.

/r/guildwars2 made a community made google doc about the endgame some year ago that I think has been updated since. Check it out!

I play with my wife too. We still have fun, but we're completionists, we want to do everything!

On a usual basis we will do Teq, Dungeons, map completion on an alt, and dailies.

The best variety after playing this game a long time is WvW though. We're in a fun guild and do 10-20 man groups a couple times per week. You should play however you like to have fun. These are just the end game things that occupy me after 2000 hours in the game.

It also really helps to have a goal. Right now I'm working on all the cultural armor skins for the title. I have 1 of each race so I'm trying to buy 1 piece per day and at least 1 T3 piece per week... eventually it'll get done this way.
